meaning.vi: Theo một cách nói; một cách thuyết phục.

meaning_vi: có hiệu quả đáng chú ý; gân ấn tượng mạnh

sentences.en: He tellingly took a seat next to his secretary and not next to his wife.
sentences.vi: Anh ta bảo đảm ngồi cạnh thư ký chứ không phải cạnh vợ.

sentences.en: Most tellingly, perhaps, chimpanzees do not draw as much information from the world around them as we do.

sentences.en: The younger ones, tellingly, are closer to the disc.
sentences.vi: Những người trẻ tuổi, đáng chú ý, gần với đĩa hơn.

sentences.en: Most tellingly, Labour's vote was well down on its 1990 performance in the provinces. Sentencedict.com

sentences.en: Tellingly, the publicly owned Tennessee Valley Authority is the only utility to have expressed interest recently in nuclear power.

sentences.en: But, more tellingly, many legal residents are hastily becoming citizens.

sentences.en: Tellingly, huge increases in those behaviors were all launched at around the same time, the era of Woodstock and Stonewall.

sentences.en: Tellingly, however, those improvements occurred only as that transformation in their management system approach actually took place.

sentences.en: This is revealed most tellingly when informants are given a passage that appears incoherent.
